description: Source code implementing the internal logic of a media player component, including media time calculation, player state management, and configuration retrieval.

classes.name: SbPlayerPrivate
classes.description: Class managing internal state and operations of a media player instance, including seeking, configuration, and media info updates.

methods.name: CalculateMediaTime
methods.description: Calculates current media time based on elapsed time and playback rate.

methods.name: CreateInstance
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate SbPlayerPrivate objects.

methods.name: Seek
methods.description: Seeks the media player to a specified time.

methods.name: WriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Signals end of stream for a given media type.

methods.name: SetBounds
methods.description: Sets rendering bounds for the video output.

methods.name: GetInfo
methods.description: Retrieves current player information such as timestamp, size, volume, and frame counts.

methods.name: UpdateMediaInfo
methods.description: Updates internal media timing and frame drop info based on external updates.

methods.name: GetCurrentDecodeTarget
methods.description: Retrieves the current decode target for rendering.

methods.name: GetAudioConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves available audio configurations, prioritizing HDMI connector if available.
